{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age < 0 (invalid age)
valid_df = df[df['customer_age'] >= 0]

# Now filter for converted customers from the valid data
converted_customers_valid = valid_df[valid_df['converted'] == 1]

# Compute the mean age of converted customers with valid age
mean_age_converted_valid = converted_customers_valid['customer_age'].mean()

mean_age_converted_valid"}
